diff --git a/django/db/models/deletion.py b/django/db/models/deletion.py
index 92fe4affb9..c038a56642 100644
--- a/django/db/models/deletion.py
+++ b/django/db/models/deletion.py
@@ -324,4 +324,9 @@ class Collector:
         for model, instances in self.data.items():
             for instance in instances:
                 setattr(instance, model._meta.pk.attname, None)
+        # fast_deletes may have been added for models without dependencies
+        for qs in self.fast_deletes:
+            model = qs.model if hasattr(qs, 'model') else type(qs)
+            for obj in qs:
+                setattr(obj, model._meta.pk.attname, None)
         return sum(deleted_counter.values()), dict(deleted_counter)
